name: MVP
summary: Ready to build the first working version. Adds a spec convention (/spec + FEAT-NNN with validated-learning + evals + failure-states fields), a stack-configured build gate (/smoke), evals discipline (/evals — Husain; v0.30 requires failure-mode categories for AI-mediated FEATs), demand-testing discipline (/pretotype — Savoia), JIT design-tokens scaffolding (/design-tokens-init — Frost / Curtis), AI cost discipline (/ai-cost — cohort-aware budgets + per-call logger; v0.25) + cost review cadence (/cost-review reads the ledger; v0.30), the AI-first template (/ai-first-init conductor + /ai-failure-states for the five failure modes with Eval-tested fields; v0.26+v0.30 — bakes in eval + cost + schema + failure-state design from day one), the extraction discipline (/extract + extraction-loop encoding PRINCIPLE #1's UP/DOWN router via LLM-as-judge; v0.29), the deep whole-project drift audit (/drift-deep — the 1M-context 'am I fooling myself across everything' counterpart to the cheap drift hook moment; v0.37), the revalidation gate (/revalidate — the 3-line 'still relevant? still aligned? anything changed?' check before paused work re-enters build, so you never ship a zombie feature; ported UP from the dhun dogfood, v0.48), trace error-analysis (/judge-traces — Hamel/Shankar applied to your own `.boss/trace.jsonl`: read real session traces, sort failures into a binary taxonomy, route recurring modes to /boss-learn; the deliberate reader for the auto-log substrate, v0.53), the mentor board orchestrator (/consult — convene the mentors who have a stake in a cross-cutting question, get each lens in its own voice, synthesize with the disagreement kept visible and the humane override; advisory only; IDEA-022 Track 2, v0.57), the shared craft commons (/practice — capture a better way to build with AI as a shared, attributed, staleness-aware PRAC-NNN your cofounder gets too, so the team stays current on the fast-moving agentic-AI craft together instead of re-learning it; v0.78, IDEA-037 slice 4), the deploy/reachability discipline (/ship — the CD half of building: detect the stack, run a deploy-time pre-flight against the signature vibe-coded-leak surface (no client-bundled secrets; server-side authz/RLS actually on — CVE-2025-48757/MoltBook), pick the cheapest reversible host, hand back the live URL + the rollback path; stack-neutral, the pre-flight is a check not a gate; v0.92, FEAT-024), the first-landing-page generator (/landing — compose BRAND.md voice/positioning + design tokens + the canvas Promises cell into an on-brand first page, humane-checked so it converts honestly (no fake urgency/confirmshaming), then hand to /ship; product-page vs demand-page = /pretotype's fake door; generates the simple on-brand case, hands off CMS/visual-editing to Framer/Carrd; v0.112, get-it-out-the-block-not-a-CRO-tool), the post-ship measurement runner (/measure — the /pretotype counterpart: pick ONE activation metric + ONE retention curve, ≤10 events, add the AI-product metrics classic analytics misses (task-completion rate, edit-rate, cost-per-successful-outcome), free/OSS/no-lock-in; humane by construction — measures graduation not engagement, says 'go talk to your users' at n<10; v0.113), the post-launch verdict AND diagnosis in one verb (/health — renders pre/at/post-PMF from Sean-Ellis-40% + retention-curve flattening + pull-vs-push, DEFAULTING to pre-PMF because premature scaling is the #1 startup killer, then — when the curve sags — rebases past the week-2-5 AI-tourist wave to the Month-3 cohort and says WHERE it dies: top=activation→/onboard, middle=engagement→product+/roadmap+/interview-the-churned, wallet=involuntary→dunning-plumbing-point-at-Stripe; voiced through the seller→operator→leader ladder; a verdict not a dashboard, 'go talk to them' at n<10; `boss craft retention`), the activation designer (/onboard — the top-of-curve fix /health routes to: derive the aha-moment from data (best-retained vs churned cohort, not a whiteboard guess), shrink time-to-value, run concierge onboarding BY HAND for the first users (Superhuman / do-things-that-don't-scale — it doubles as /interview); humane — activation = getting them to SUCCESS fast not HOOKED fast; `boss craft activation`), the what-to-build-next weigher (/roadmap — the fuller version of /spec's loud≠important check: weigh feedback vs behavior into a SMALL Shape-Up bet-list + a mandatory NO-list, Confidence=the EVID grade (Gilad's meter on BOSS's ladder), RICE-reach OFF by default, behavior outranks requests, pre-PMF the roadmap is just 'find fit'; a snapshot you use and discard, NOT a Gantt/backlog you tend; humane — serves the silent majority not whoever shouts; v0.123), the money verb (/money — reads where you are and routes — no yes yet → /interview; a real yes but no rail → the five deferrable moves (entity / ToS+privacy / payment rail = cheapest-reversible payment-link-before-billing-system / refund posture / the first price said out loud) ending in the commitment-grade EVID so the first dollar doesn't evaporate; paying customers → operating it (behavior-triggered upgrades = a moment of value not a nag, dunning for the 20-40% involuntary churn = plumbing, point at Stripe, don't build billing, the humane price-raise = raise on value with an escape clause never a stealth raise, and expansion ONLY when usage tracks the customer's success not lock-in/struggle), checking the margin underneath via /cost-review's gross-margin band + the margin-trap moment; bright line — pointers to professionals never legal/tax advice, records the EVENT not the STREAM (no MRR dashboard); the conscience shifts validate→deliver once first revenue exists; `boss craft first-dollar` + `boss craft monetization-in-practice`). /cost-review now writes a gross-margin band (cost-per-active-user vs price + Evergreen-Ratio) that answers + closes the margin-trap moment. the earn-trust-honestly runner (/trust — the AI-specific privacy/compliance load-bearing set without the SOC2 theater: a data-minimization privacy policy (what/why/how-long/how-to-delete) + ToS + retention/deletion path, a subprocessor list auto-derived from what the app actually uses (LLM provider, vector DB, observability), the config act founders skip — 'did you actually turn on the provider's training opt-out?' (an act not a promise — 'the AI did it' is not a legal defense, Air-Canada), and a public trust-page stub; explicitly DEFERS SOC2/ISO/DPIA until a NAMED enterprise deal demands them; bright line — pointers to a real lawyer never legal advice; humane — privacy as respect, data minimization as the cheapest+kindest posture; /ship's pre-flight + /money hand off here; v0.127, closes the IDEA-012 privacy backlog gap). Plus a devlog (/log), and a session-end ritual (/close + RESUME.md). the competitive field survey (/comp-eval — find who else solves this incl. the spreadsheet/agency/doing-nothing rows that actually win, with a source URL + checked-date on every claim or it is marked unverified; a LIVING set under docs/competition/ you add rivals to, never a scoreboard; v0.190.0). Design arrives HERE as of v0.189.0 (DEC-005): one `designer` owning both halves — the visual system (tokens, type, spacing, motion) and flow/state/interaction (the five-state requirement, error and empty states, accessibility) — plus /design-review before code and /ux-check after. It replaces the ui-designer/ux-designer split, which BOSS shipped to founders while running a single designer itself, and whose two descriptions had to be glossed every time they were named. AI-generated UI reliably nails the happy path and skips empty/loading/disabled/error, and that lands the first week a founder builds a screen — not at V1. Builders: tester + planner + designer (the merged visual+flow authority — moved DOWN from V1 in v0.190.0 and merged from ui-designer + ux-designer, because the token apparatus it owns already shipped at MVP: /design-tokens-init, the design-tokens-guard hook, design-tokens-loop and /landing. The two AI-UI failure modes it exists for — missing states and token drift — land in week one, not at V1; /design-review and /ux-check came down with it, while /design-library and design-drift-loop stay at V1 where a real component set exists to render and enforce). Mentors: architect + customers + money + cofounder. `mentor-capital` is the SINGLE venture coach (DEC-006, v0.189.0): model + pricing at this rung, with the raise question and the investor story becoming live at V1 as its remit WIDENS rather than two more agents arriving — it absorbed mentor-fundraising and mentor-pitch, and moved down from V1 in the first place because /money ships here and its first-price step named it as owner. `mentor-cofounder` (the founding-team relationship — coaches a TEAM on working together across skill sets, the non-tech↔eng cofounder gap, and the hard conversations; never takes a side; v0.79, IDEA-037 slice 5). Plus 8 named loops on the v0.18 primitive — spec-loop (moment #4 restraint), pretotype-loop (Savoia), design-tokens-loop (IDEA-010), cost-budget-loop (Husain-applied-to-spend; v0.25), ai-failure-state-loop (Husain failure-mode discipline applied to UX; v0.26), extraction-loop (PRINCIPLE #1's own discipline; v0.29), cost-review-loop (the cadence /ai-cost only declared; v0.30), drift-loop (work-vs-named-risk — the closest loop to why BOSS exists; predicate-gated model judgment, v0.31), and margin-trap-loop (the post-launch cost→price bridge — fires when there's a real cost ledger + a cost review but none has looked at the margin; the model judges cost-per-active-user vs your price AND the humane profit-from-struggle read on retries/regenerations; a16z/Tunguz + PRINCIPLE #6, v0.118).
